I submitted a verified verdict: the finding stands. The comment says "Checking MBOX USER INFO", but the code at `cptra_ss_mcu_mbox_test.c:112-117` only reads the USER register over AXI DMA and prints it. Nothing compares the value or sets `fail`, so that step can never fail the test.

I read only the lines around the cited code and grepped the `smoke_test_mcu_mbox` directory for `MBOX_USER`. I did not open the test plan spreadsheet or search elsewhere in the repository.

The only other USER access is in `smoke_test_mcu_mbox.c:115-116`, on the MCU side. It polls until USER is non-zero, which is a different step from the one in the finding.
